verdict.rationale: Documented I/O headroom is a fair question for a desktop CPU platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions PCIe generation or lane counts, storage interfaces, or external connectivity such as Thunderbolt or USB. The spec-page items cover only cache and clocks, ECC, vPro, and AI frameworks, and the community items discuss memory speeds and performance, which are adjacent topics that earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform has documented I/O headroom — PCIe generation and lanes, fast storage, and external connectivity specs I can plan a build or dock setup around
